interval_years.quote: Upon receipt of the annual renewal fee, the Board shall issue a renewal certificate authorizing the dentist, dental hygienist, or dental assistant to continue the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene, respectively, in this state for a period of one (1) year.

required.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education with no more than twenty (20) hours to be completed online.

hours_per_period.quote: Dentists shall complete forty (40) hours of continuing education with no more than twenty (20) hours to be completed online.

period_years.quote: Continuing education requirements shall be due at the end of each two-year period.

available.quote: A dentist holding a general dentist license in good standing and having practiced for at least five hundred (500) hours within the previous five (5) years immediately prior to application and having passed a regional examination substantially equivalent to the requirements for this state may apply for licensure by credentials

requirements.value: Dentist must hold a general dentist license in good standing, have practiced at least 500 hours within the previous 5 years, have passed a substantially equivalent regional examination, provide a letter of good standing from all states ever licensed in, meet qualifications in subsections B and C of Section 328.21, and pass the jurisprudence examination.
requirements.quote: A dentist or dental hygienist currently licensed in another state having met the qualifications in paragraphs 1 through 3 of subsections B and C of this section may apply for a license by credentials

exists.quote: there is hereby created the Board of Dentistry which shall be an agency of state government. The Board shall adopt a seal, sue and be sued in its own name, and implement and enforce the provisions of the State Dental Act.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to hold oneself out to the public as a dentist or as a person who practices dentistry

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, except a licensed dentist, to practice or attempt to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted of, a felony, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, sex offender crimes, violent crimes, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement, or controlled substances violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pleading guilty or nolo contendere to, or being convicted of, a felony, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, any crime in which an individual would be required to be a registered sex offender under state law, any violent crime, Medicaid fraud, insurance fraud, identity theft, embezzlement or a violation of federal or state controlled dangerous substances laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting a false diploma, license, or certificate, or one obtained by fraud or illegal means, or providing false information on an application or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Presenting to the Board a false diploma, license, or certificate, or one obtained by fraud or illegal means, or providing other false information on an application or renewal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incompetent due to persistent inebriety or addiction to drugs, or failing to notify the Board of a licensee practicing while impaired
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being, by reason of persistent inebriety or addiction to drugs, incompetent to continue the practice of dentistry or failing to notify the Board of a licensee, permit holder, or other health professional that is practicing while impaired

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing a false, fraudulent, or misleading advertisement or statement

disciplinary_grounds.description: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene or to perform a function requiring a Board permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Authorizing or aiding an unlicensed person to practice dentistry, to practice dental hygiene or to perform a function for which a permit from the Board is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay fees as required by the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete continuing education requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing oneself as a dental specialist without holding the required dental specialty license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing himself or herself to the public as a specialist in a dental specialty without holding a dental specialty license as listed in Section 328.22 of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing below the basic standard of care that an ordinary prudent dentist with similar training and experience would have provided
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing below the basic standard of care of a patient which an ordinary prudent dentist with similar training and experience within the local area would have provided

disciplinary_grounds.description: Endangering patients by continuing to practice dentistry with a highly communicable disease without appropriate safeguards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Endangering the health of patients by reason of having a highly communicable disease and continuing to practice dentistry without taking appropriate safeguards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place, including repeated failures to follow CDC or OSHA guidelines
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry in an unsafe or unsanitary manner or place including but not limited to repeated failures to follow Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) or Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) guidelines

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be mentally unsound
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be mentally unsound

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being shown to be grossly immoral and that such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being shown to be grossly immoral and that such condition represents a threat to patient care or treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being incompetent to practice dentistry while delivering care to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing repeated acts of negligence in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to divide or splitting fees with any person in exchange for referral of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering to effect or effecting a division of fees, or agreeing to split or divide a fee for dental services with any person, in exchange for the person bringing or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being involuntarily committed to an institution for treatment for substance abuse, until recovery or remission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using services of a dental laboratory or technician without issuing a laboratory prescription
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using or attempting to use the services of a dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician without issuing a laboratory prescription

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists per dentist actively practicing in the same dental office
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having more than the equivalent of three full-time dental hygienists for each dentist actively practicing in the same dental office

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully disclosing information protected by HIPAA
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully disclosing information protected by the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, P.L. 104-191

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for a controlled dangerous substance or prescribing opioids in excess of statutory maximum limits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Writing a false, unnecessary, or excessive prescription for any drug or narcotic which is a controlled dangerous substance under either federal or state law, or prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without having established a valid dentist-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or administering any drug or treatment without having established a valid dentist-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in nonconsensual sexual physical contact with a patient or sexually demeaning verbal communication to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in nonconsensual physical contact with a patient which is sexual in nature, or engaging in a verbal communication which is intended to be sexually demeaning to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry without displaying the Board-issued license and current renewal certificate at the primary place of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry without displaying, at the dentist's primary place of practice, the license issued to the dentist by the Board to practice dentistry and the current renewal certificate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being dishonest in a material way with a patient or during the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven years from the date of last treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to retain all patient records for at least seven (7) years from the date of the last treatment as provided by Section 328.31b of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a non-dentist corporation, organization, or entity (other than another dentist or compliant professional entity) to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing any corporation, organization, group, person, or other legal entity, except another dentist or a professional entity that is in compliance with the registration requirements of subsection B of Section 328.31 of this title, to direct, control, or interfere with the dentist's clinical judgment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the dental act of another state resulting in guilty plea, conviction, or license suspension/revocation by another state board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the state dental act of another state resulting in a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, conviction or suspension or revocation or other sanction by another state board, of the license of the dentist under the laws of that state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate the provisions of the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate the provisions of the State Dental Act or the rules of the Board, a state or federal statute or rule relating to scheduled drugs, fraud, a violent crime or any crime for which the penalty includes the requirement of registration as a sex offender in this state as a principal, accessory or accomplice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the terms and conditions of an order imposing suspension or probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the terms and conditions of an order imposing suspension of a license or placement on probation issued pursuant to Section 328.44a of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information to the Board or its investigators
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to cooperate during an investigation or providing false information, verbally or in writing, to the Board, the Board's investigator or an agent of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having multiple administrative or civil actions reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having multiple administrative or civil actions reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one year of obtaining a license or violating controlled substance prescribing laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to complete an approved two-hour course on opioid and scheduled drug prescribing within one (1) year of obtaining a license or a violation of a law related to controlled dangerous substances including prescribing laws pursuant to Section 2-309D of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide patient records as required by state statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide patient records as provided by Sections 19 and 20 of Title 76 of the Oklahoma Statutes

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any person holding an Oklahoma specialty license that does not have an Oklahoma general dentistry license shall be limited to practicing that specialty for which they hold a license.
